lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Ah, a visitor! Forgive me, I'm Barnaby, and I'm afraid I'm in rather a <color=red>predicament</color>.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Three of my most treasured books have <color=red>vanished</color>. I had them with me only this morning.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: I suspect I set them down during my <color=red>meandering</color> walk around the camp, and promptly forgot where.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Would you be willing to <color=red>retrieve</color> them for me? You'll spot them easily, since they'll be spinning in the open.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Bring them back and I shall be <color=red>eternally</color> grateful.

inProgressLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
inProgressLines.text: Any sign of my books yet? They're <color=red>scattered</color> across the camp, and I'm quite anxious to have them returned.

inProgressLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
inProgressLines.text: Do keep searching. I have every <color=red>faith</color> in you.

completeLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
completeLines.text: All three! I scarcely dared to <color=red>hope</color> you would find them.

completeLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
completeLines.text: <color=red>Well done</color>, truly. You've shown real <color=red>perseverance</color>, and I'm indebted to you.

afterLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
afterLines.text: I can't thank you enough for recovering my books. They're <color=red>safe</color> with me now, I promise.
